## 🧪 Testing Strategy
<!-- Describe the tests added or modified to verify this change -->

- [ ] Ran full test suite locally (`npm test`)

---

## ✅ Contributor Checklist

- [ ] **Test Pairing**: Feature (`feat:`) or Bugfix (`fix:`) is paired and committed with its tests in the same commit.
- [ ] **Conventional Commits**: Commit message(s) adhere to `feat(...)`, `fix(...)`, `refactor(...)`, etc.
- [ ] **Linting & Formatting**: Code passes `npm run lint` and `npm run format:check`.
- [ ] **Typecheck**: `npm run typecheck` passes without errors.
- [ ] **Production Build**: `npm run build` succeeds.

---

## 👥 Code Review & Peer Approval

- [ ] **Peer Review**: Reviewed and approved by at least one co-maintainer or community contributor.
- [ ] **Release Batching**: Tagged for the next incremental release batch (following SemVer).
